job_title: Principal, Enterprise Platform Governance & CMDB Strategy
job_description:
Fortune 300 life sciences organization mid-way through a multi-year ServiceNow platform consolidation needs a Principal-level advisor to own CMDB/CSDM governance strategy and rebuild executive confidence in configuration data quality following a series of failed automation rollouts tied to unreliable CI data. Assessment-first engagement: first 6 weeks focused on platform health audit and technical debt evaluation, transitioning into governance framework design and executive roadmap delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct a ground-up assessment of the existing CMDB/CSDM implementation, service mapping accuracy, and discovery governance across IT, HR, and Compliance domains.
- Design a governance-by-design operating model for configuration data ownership, data quality SLAs, and platform maturity standards.
- Translate platform risk and technical debt findings into an executive-ready investment roadmap for CIO/VP stakeholders.
- Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security teams to align CMDB governance with AI-readiness and observability initiatives already underway.
- Establish platform health KPIs and executive dashboards to sustain governance visibility post-engagement.

Ideal Background:
- 10+ years leading ServiceNow platform governance or CMDB/CSDM strategy at Fortune 500 scale, ideally in a regulated industry (healthcare, life sciences, or similar).
- Demonstrated experience assessing inherited platforms with significant technical debt and rebuilding executive trust in configuration data.
- Track record advising CIO/VP/SVP stakeholders and translating technical platform risk into investment decisions.
- Comfortable operating independently as a senior advisor in a trusted-advisor engagement, not staff augmentation.
tailoring_focus: CMDB governance, CSDM strategy, ServiceNow platform health, technical debt assessment, executive advisory, CIO/VP stakeholder alignment, AI-readiness, regulated industry, configuration data quality
